notes.title: Update 0.8.8
notes.content:
1) New Hero Class: Elementalist
Class focused entirely on elemental-based skills.

Very flexible, fit for spellcasting builds but also for close combat due to skills like Fire Shield, Electric Hook and Shock Strike.

Make sure to bring physical-attack minions for dealing with elemental-resist enemies!



Perks:

+30 elemental strength

Immunity to Burn and Frost (does not include burning ground)

+1 stacks for Negative Effects

Upgrades:

+1 Momentum on enemy stunned

+10 Upgrade Points per effect on turn start

+30 elemental resistance

Skills:

Electric Hook: Ability, drag target unit and deal stability damage.

Tempest: Passive, at the start of your turn deal damage to the enemy with lowest stability and attempt to stun it.

Rainbow Strike: Spell - Ultimate, Apply X Stacks randomly distributed between Burn, Frost and Acid to target enemy.

Ice Shard: Attack, Deal elemental damage with high accuracy and high critical damage multiplier.

Fire Shield: Spell, Applies fire shield to a friendly unit (enemies take damage when attacking it in melee)

Summon Fire Elemental: Spell - Summon, Can control only one at a time.

Shock Strike: Attack, Deal elemental damage, AP damage, and stuns. High accuracy and high AP cost.

Amplify Effect: Ability, Increase all effects on target unit by 1 stack.


2) UI Improvements
You can now adjust scrolling and zooming speed.

You can reset tutorials

More graphic options.
3) Balancing


Reduced difficulty increase after entering a new region

Regeneration now scales with stacks

Open Wounds is now stackable and scales with stacks

Night imp: increased initiative, increased base damage of sacrilege

Skeletal Drake: reduced damage, accuracy and hp

Summoned Wolf: lowered hp

Corruption Crystals: lowered hp (by a lot)







And fixed some bugs and issues that were reported, thanks for all the feedback!



More updates coming soon

notes.title: Update 0.8.7
notes.content:
I'm posting this with a few days of delay due to all the early access release madness.

If you've been playing, you probably already saw most of what I'll mention here.



It's been a crazy weekend but fortunately everything is going well!


1) New Boss Relics:
Anchor: +3 Max Stability to your Hero

Ring of Corruption: Increase experience gain from combat by 1% per Corruption

Magic Scissors: Upgrading costs 0 AP for all of your units


2) New Common Relics
Spyglass: Increasy visibility on stage selection by 1

White Flag: Reduce threat level of all stages by 5

Demon Ring: +3 Starting Momentum to all Demons

Gear: +2 Free Upgrades each combat

Corrupted Chest: Gain extra Gold each combat equal to Corruption

Scroll of Healing: +30 Healing Strength to your Hero

Power Boots: +1 Movement to your Hero

Nails: +1 Max Specialization Upgrades to all your Minions


3) New environment: Hellfire
For Abyss region.



All units get 1 stack of Bloodlust for starting or ending a turn in lower ground.

All units except Demons additionaly take 10 damage.


4) Difficulty Selection
Default difficulty is now slightly lower than before.

Each time you win a run, you'll be able to increase difficulty by +1, up to infinity.



The average threat level of each stage is increased by 2 multiplied for the current region number. So the difference may be subtle at first but will scale rapidly.

You will also grow your Squad faster, since both exp and gold gains are scaled with threat level (but not enough to cancel out the increase in difficulty).



Bosses also get +10 base HP per difficulty level.

Don't let Corruption get too high or you'll struggle with this!


5) Combat Balancing


Snake, Wolf and Spiderling do not block sight anymore.

Accuracy and Evasion penalty from Frost now scales with each stack

100% displace chance against obstacles (except unmovable, I also added the "Unmovable" classification in the UI frame)

Lowered HP for most obstacles

Goblin Priest: Higher attack base damage, lower Holy Punch damage

Goblin Pyromancer: Higher attack base damage





And plenty of minor issues fixed.

Thank you for all the useful feedback, keep it coming!

notes.title: Update 0.8.6
notes.content:
1) New Class: Necromancer
Perks:

Life Tap (ability - Lose 10 HP, gain 1 Momentum)

+100 upgrade points when any unit dies (including summoned)

Immunity to Bleed and Poison

Upgrades:

+20% Lifesteal to all attacks

+1 momentum on enemy taking bleed damage (reaction)

+30% base damage for summoned units

Skills:

Bone Arrow (ranged physical attack: apply bleed on impact)

Steal Effect (ability: steal one random positive effect from target unit)

Death Ripple (spell: deal elemental damage to all non-undead units)

Medium Stance (ability - stance: while active, summon a ghost at the start of your turn) (ghost level scales with necromancer's elemental strength at the moment of summoning)

Blood Curse (spell: apply Blood Curse to target enemy (prevent healing once))

Undead Rage (spell: apply Undead Rage to target undead unit (gains initiative but loses hp per turn))

Bone Shield (ability: gain block)

Spirit bomb (ranged elemental attack with AOE: increased damage for each unit killed this combat)(including summoned)

This brings a lot of new posibilities, I can't wait to see how you combine it with other classes!




2) New Prop Spawning System
Now, each environment has a set of pre-defined props that can spawn on the platform, and other set for the low ground.

The exact amount of each prop and their positions are randomized at the start of each match.

On average, there are more props than before. Now it's easier to take cover, block enemy movement, etc.

Remember that most props can be displaced, use this to your advantage!

(pickups / collectibles are not affected by this change)



New prop, Qualdron: +30% elemental strength to all adjacent units. When destroyed, apply 3 stacks of Acid to all adjacent units.

(the only prop that's both benefical and dangerous!)




3) Swamp Environment
Units get 1 stack of poison for starting or ending a turn on low ground.



Platform props: explosive barrel, low rock, cauldron

Low ground props: tall rock, cauldron, tree stump


4) Blight Environment
Undead units Heal 10 HP for starting or ending a turn on low ground.

All other units Lose 10 HP.



Platform props: tall rock, cauldron

Low ground props: none





More updates soon!

notes.title: Update 0.8.5
notes.content:
1) Village Environment
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/c67a0f5676156c044c5d3cb013a348b22a376073.png"]

New environment for "Imperial City" region.

Wooden Logs: Grant 100 Upgrade Points when picked up. (they spawn at combat start, not over time)

Water Wells: +1 momentum per turn to adjacent units. Always spawn off platform. Very hard to destroy, can't be displaced.

Haystacks: Block movement and sight. Can spawn anywhere. Very easy to destroy or displace. 

No special penalties for going off platform. (only the normal damage/resistance penalty)


2) New Skills
Barbarian:

Iron Skin (spell): Increase Physical and Elemental Resistance but decrease Evasion.

Vengeance (passive): Increase Initiative for each friendly unit killed this combat (including summons).

Warcry (ability): Grants Blood Lust to all nearby friendly units.

Fire Dash (ability): Charges towards target unit 2 or 3 tiles away. Deal elemental damage, apply Burn and displace target.



Shaman:

Poison Cloud (spell): Apply Poison to all units in a small area anywhere in the map.

Summon Bear (spell): Summons a slow but powerful bear with Roar and Stability Damage on attacks. Can't be controlled. (will always use Roar if available)

Mass Ward (spell): Apply Ward to all nearby friendly units.

Insight (passive): Gain Upgrade Points at the start of your turn.



Paladin:

Holy Chant (ability - ultimate): All friendly units gain X Momentum, all enemy units lose X Momentum.

Breach (attack): Apply Breach on impact (reduces elemental resistance)

Curse Shield (passive): On defending, apply Weakness to a random enemy.

Holy Light (spell): Deal damage to undead and demons and heal everyone else in a small area.


3) New Relics
Spyglass: +1 free information level on stage selection

Ring of Nature: Gain a Wolf minion each stage.


4) Improved Performance
Upgraded to Unity 6 and made a lot of adjustments, which led to much better performance.

FPS seems to be up to 50% higher (specially when there are lots of units simultaneosly).

Nobody has ever complained about performance. However, as the game grows, I think it's important to do constant maintenance so it continues to run smoothly!





And plenty of fixing minor issues and combat balancing.



The game is almost ready for Early Access, only a few weeks from now!

Thanks a lot to all the players that have been giving great feedback!



More updates coming soon

notes.title: Update 0.8.4
notes.content:
1) Corrupted Environment
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/a36d4581a90fca084a8d94e056a7e3218ba566ac.png"]New environment for the Final Region.

Floor tiles do damage equal to corruption level whenever a non-corrupted enter or end a turn in these tiles. (corrupted units are not affected).




2) New items
Sorcerer's Tunic: -10 AP cost for all spells. +20 Elemental Resistance

Sorcerer's Helm: +1 Range for all spells. +10 Elemental Resistance




3) Skill Hotkeys
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/537d166c86093a930d86f360af1d1b717a970a81.png"]

Activate any action of the top row with keys F1 to F12, bottom row with numbers from 1 to 0.

For actions that do not require target, it will ask you to press the same key again to confirm.

By default, keys are not shown (for aesthethic reasons). Once you press any hotkey, all of them become visible for the entire turn.




4) Re-roll main rewards
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/eb0936f0d3b47d126f11283d993277f90222f6bb.png"]

You'll get 3 new options (from the same category).

The chance of corrupted rewards appearing is calculated again on rerolling.




5) Notifications when unlocking a new class or new skills
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/260e373a815cca188cc5ac815e56418bc1f91413.png"]




6) Game progress bar
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/3728ee7e1a7b4ec4d0c2306acf7f3b246a5cab33.png"]

Fill the stage slots as you progress through the run (the current stage flickers).

Length varies depending on game mode.




7) Combat balancing
Energy Orb: Momentum gain now scales with item level

Slash: Now applies 2 stacks of bleed (used to be 1)

Goblin Thief: Can steal up to 100 upgrade points from the opposite squad (ability)

Tribal Hunter: Slightly reduced Accuracy, Evasion, Physical Strength and Base Damage





More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.8.3
notes.content:
1) Corruption

New core gameplay feature.
You now have a "Corruption" counter, visible at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/7be4f4e2b16edf30790fdd63033c2acdca0b43e7.png


 Corrupted enemies and gain +1% HP per Corruption point. (all bosses are corrupted)
 Increases the chance of Corrupted enemies appearing by +1% per Corruption point.
 Increases by 1 for each turn elapsed during combat.
 Increases by 10 after selecting a Corrupted reward. (purple frame - corrupted rewards can be slightly better than what you'd normaly get for that stage)
 Corruption is reduced by 5 for killing a Corrupted Minions, 10 for Corrupted Heroes (including Bosses)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/0611d4047292d5610568d9390a8b0e784d94fb4d.png

Boss stages now have "Corruption Crystals", each crystal grants a passive bonus to Corrupted enemies of +30% damage resistance.
The resistance bonus is fixed. However, the HP of the crystals is increased by Corruption.
Spawning position is random but always within 3 tiles of the Boss.
If the ground is lava, then they always spawn on the platform (but you can push them into the lava!).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/5a8743f3713ebc5b4bfab45b80ded5c44a21b059.png

New Relic: Corruption Catalyst: Gain 1 gold per Corruption point at the end of each stage.

I will soon add corrupted hero items that get their stats increased by current corruption level (so at least you can get something possitive if corruption gets too high), and more ways to increase or decrease corruption.



2) New Minion: Killer Bot

Level 3, Mechanical / Flying

 High movement, attack damage and accuracy.
 Low HP and resistance. Medium evasion.
 +50% damage to Heroes
 Immune to most status effects
 Stab (attack, ignores resistance from stability and breaks defense after impact, can only be used against isolated enemies)
 Self Destruct (ability, deals 50 elemental damage to all adjacent units and high stun chance)


More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.8.2
notes.content:
1) New Minions

Introducing a new skill, Aura of Decay: All living minions lose 2% HP on starting a turn. 1% HP for Heroes (does not stack)

Zombie Warrior - Level 3 - Undead / Humanoid

 Aura of Decay
 Regenerates 10 HP on starting a turn. 
 Low initiative and movement, high resistances.
 Can attack twice per turn, but very low accuracy.


Zombie Hound- Level 6 - Undead / Beast

 Aura of Decay
 Regenerates 15 HP on starting a turn.
 Can Leap up to 3 tiles away.
 Can use Roar (grants Fury to friendly units, extra stacks for friendly beasts).
 Low initiative but high movement, mid resistances.
 Can attack twice per turn, mid accuracy, inflicts open wounds on impact.



2) Combat balancing


 Reduced HP of explosive barrels, but also reduced damage of exploding
 Increased base displace chance for all skills, specially for push
 Meteor now deals 2 stability damage
 Reduced momentum cost for holy punch but reduced base damage
 Frost arrow now applies 2 stacks of Frost 
 Reduced initiative, accuracy and evasion for Imperial Swordman
 Increased stun chance for crush
 Reduced initiative of Skeleton Mage, but increased elemental strength



3) Improved enemy AI

Plenty of adjustments, but most notoriously:

 AI internally assigns a priority value to each player unit, depending on how much of a potential threat it is to the current AI squad. Ej: if AI has a lot of beasts, enemy hunters get higher priority because they do bonus damage to beasts. This priority is one of the main factors when deciding which unit to attack or debuff.
 When chosing a target to apply a status effect, it now considers more factors like priority, remaining HP, momentum and stability, how close it is to the opposite team's units, and how close it is to key tiles like runes or control zones.
 AI now adapts it's "personality" over time to reflect the current situation. This include several variables like aggresiveness, friendly hero protection, enemy hero focus, upgrade priorities and much more.



4) Aesthethics Improvements


 Re-done all the environments in Enchanted Forest and Permafrost Peaks from scratch. This includes terrain, trees or rocks surrounding the playable area, lightning and effects like snow, fog, rain and fireflies.
 Improved lot of visual effects, mostly for spells.
 Lot of UI improvements





More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
I'm happy to inform that after a lot of hard work I finally released a demo for everyone to play!
It includes:

 5 playable Hero Classes (2 of them need to be unlocked first)
 3 Regions, 8 different environments
 14 hero items
 12 playable minions
 12 minor relics, 5 boss relics
 You can play up to defeating the second Boss
 

The demo will be constantly updated to reflect the latest progress.

I'm also happy to inform that the game will be released on Early Access by the end of June.
I put a lot of thought into this and decided it's best to release as early as possible to get more feedback from a bigger audience.
You can read the full details in the "Early Access" section of the game's main page.


Accessibility for new players:
I listened to the feedback from new players and they made it clear that they prefer to jump into action asap.
Hence, after creating your hero, your first region is selected automatically (enchanted forest) as well as your first stage (skirmish, no mods, minion reward) and go straight to combat. If you win, you select the second stage manually as usual. Once you clear the first region, this won't apply in future runs and you get to play normally.

I also simplified the tutorial and spread it across several turns.

Improved tile and environment effects
Added rain effect for fantasy forest and falling snow for permafrost peaks, but with random variations.
Also randomized lightning to portrait fighting at different hours.
I'm thinking of adding some bonuses and penalties for specific minions on different weathers, but for now is purely aesthethic.

And I replaced all the flat and boring tile effects and made them fancy, glowing and animated:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/86a368d490f5dc6e99282fbee456863a3fd2323e.png


Made plenty of improvements to the character creation GUI.
Fixed some bugs.
Made some combat balance.


Thanks to everyone for all the feedback!
Please keep it coming, there's plenty left to improve.
More updates soon

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
Region Selection

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/ada3a1760858dfff08fd00fbf1483ac8d3105c1c.png

You can now choose which Region to enter. Each Region has unique environments, global effects and props.
Once you enter a Region you'll have to win 4 normal stages and 1 Boss fight to clear it, before selecting the next Region.

At first you can only access Enchanted Forest and Permafrost Peaks. The other ones need to be Unlocked first (once unlocked, they remain unlocked for future runs).

Each Region has 8 randomly selected Minions, this are both the Minions that you will fight, and that you'll be able to recruit while in this Region.

Each Region has a randomly assigned Boss. Boss types can never be repeated.

You need to clear at least 3 Regions to unlock the Final Region. You can clear more Regions if you want to get even stronger (or if you just want to play longer), but the enemies in the Final Region get stronger over time as well.
The Final Boss type depends on the Region Bosses you slayed, and the order in which you slayed them.
If you win against the Final Boss, you won the run and you unlock a higher difficulty setting for future runs.

You can spend a re-roll to refresh everything, but this will not change the Bosses you already defeated.

New Environments

Energy Wisps:  +1 Momentum for starting a turn on this tile.
Has a nice visual effect that reacts to nearby units
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/e8129aaf31577632d41e9b27ff77594734c8c909.gif

Mud:  -1 Stability for entering this tile.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/99dd1fe522cab0604a3780b5345eb8994f0a887b.png


GUI Improvements

Improved targeting for skills with area of effect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/a40fc7e707b82537aed119b6a16c0b15c9372598.gif

General Runs started/won before selecting game mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/da3ef96335a271bcb10f4d75bd675540a8582965.png

Class specific Runs started/won before selecting hero class:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/b37a6ee6d3c77d9471916649d1b977656065a0cf.png

Added sound and visual feedback for all buttons and UI elements, both in combat and lobby.


Improvements to Combat

Stability now grants Physical and Elemental resistance equal to 1% of your base resistance for every 1% of current Stability.

Removed the resistance penalty for standing on Runes (there are no downsides at all now, stand on runes as much as you can!)

You always get at least 1 Minion reward on the first Stage

notes.title: Update 0.7.4
notes.content:
1) Reactions system redone

 By default, reactions can now be triggered unlimited times (unless stuned or disabled)
 The exceptions are "counter attack", "assist hero attack", "overwatch attack" and "resist melee engage" which can be triggered only once per turn, but each reaction has its own individual counter, there is no general counter anymore.
 Reactions are either innate, or from upgrades which last for the entire combat. There are no temporal reactions from skills anymore because it was a nightmare to mentally keep up with that.


 Hold Ground: removed reactions bonus, increased displacement resistance
 Archer Stance: removed reactions bonus and overwatch, reduced Action Points cost
 New Fighter Upgrade: +2 fury on taking damage from attacks
 New Cleric Upgrade: +1 momentum on friendly minion defend
 New Rogue Uñpgrade: +1 momentum on enemy taking poison damage


2) Relics on local vendor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/0f20d9c92987f32e6d5a2ad78d7b86aa0cb52921.png

 You'll now see a "local vendor" available on each stage selling random minions and relics. (replacing "sale minions")
 One minion is fixed and will remain the same through the entire region.
 One minion and two relics are temporal and will refresh on each stage.
 You can spend a reroll to get new options for all (including the fixed minion). Re-rolling after buying something will also re-stock it.
 By default, this options are 20% more expensive than in a stage market.
 Great news for relic collectors!


3) New Weapons

 Ritual Knife: Low attack AP cost, low damage, 30% backstab bonus, 30% critical damage bonus. Grants use Blood Ritual (ability, lose 10% total HP and gain 5 upgrade points per HP lost )
 Long Scepter: Mid Attack AP cost, mid damage, +30% elemental strength. Grants Death Ray (attack, hit all units in a straight line up to 4 tiles away, deals high elemental damage)


4) Combat balancing

 AP cost for upgrading is now maxed at 20
 Holy Might, Weakness: base effect slightly reduced, but now escalates with each stack
 healing bonus on items now escalates with item level
 Summoned Wolf: base damage decreased (keep in mind it escalates with the summoner's elemental strength, so it can still be quite decent damage, potentially)
 AI now gives less priority to attacking summoned units
 Holy Punch: AP cost increased, base damage increased
 Power Shot: ap cost increased, stability damage increased
 Short Sword: reduced base damage, increased critical



More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.7.3
notes.content:
1) New Targeting Interface
Added an animated arrow for better understanding of line of sight. Units or obstacles blocking sight become highlighted and you get the "target not in sight" error message.
Also added error messages for "out of range" and "invalid target type".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/155c545c1e292c9b189a9eb910925b2e198ee512.gif


2) All Hero Classes are now Main
No more sub-classes, all classes are now independent from each other.
Any class can be selected as starting class, or added later regardless of your starting class, all classes can be combined with each other allowing plenty of possible combinations.
Each Hero can combine up to 3 classes.
At first, only Fighter, Druid and Cleric classes are available. All the others have to be unlocked through specific accomplishments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/84cd44a9394d13d4b3d3399281d1694286c554bc.png


3) Acid River
New environment type.
Units take 10 damage and 1 stack of ACID when entering or starting a turn on an acid tiles.
Acid Slimes and flying units are immune to this.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/e8cade03f99a9e79a0b75f8a0b745e321b1435bd.png


4) Added Tutorial for in-combat Upgrades


5) Combat Balancing
- Sacrilege and Magic Blast are now ultimate skills (consumes all momentum, +10% damage per momentum)
- Bloodlust: initiative bonus now scales with stacks, +1 stacks when applied to demons, -1 stacks when applied to heroes
- New Rogue upgrade: +1 Momentum whenever an enemy takes damage from Poison
- New Assassin upgrade: +10% critical chance for each stack of Poison on target
- New Barbarian upgrade: +1 Momentum whenever an enemy use Defend

notes.title: Update 0.7.2
notes.content:
1) Status Effects are not divided into Physical and Elemental anymore
- Effects are not divided by type anymore, but the amount of Stacks to be applied may still be affected by Physical or Elemental strengths and resistances. This is directly correlated to the attack/spell damage type, unless specified otherwise.
- Effect removing skills (aid, cure, dispel, purge) now work on all stackable effects indistinctly.

2) Slave Market
A new non-combat stage, has a small chance of appearing instead of the normal market.
Slave markets sells only minions at half their normal price, but with -100 morale.
This can be useful if you buy minions "for later" trusting their morale will improve over time, or if you just want "meat shields" to simply stand there and take damage while not doing much else.

3) Updates to Minions and Skills

Frost Imp: Basic Attack now deals physical damage, AP cost reduced to 20
Frost Imp: Ice Shard, a new attack that deals elemental damage with high accuracy and increased damage from criticals. High AP cost

Night Imp: Basic Attack now deals physical damage, AP cost reduced to 20
Night Imp: Shadow Rush, a new attack that charges forward in a straight line up to 3 tiles away and deals elemental damage. 1 Stability Cost

Goblin Thief: Steal, a new ability that steals Upgrade Points from the enemy squad

Spiderling: Silkworks, a new ability that generates Upgrade Points, 

Dispel and Dispel Arrow: Deal +25 bonus damage to Demons

Poison Strike, Frost Arrow and Energy Burn now always deal elemental damage (regardless of weapon type), and slightly reduced damage

Roar: Apply +1 Stacks to Beasts

4) Added tutorial for Upgrades and Squad Management screen


And plenty of minor improvements, specially in the GUI

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.7.1
notes.content:
1) Added 28 achievements
Carefully thought to encourage you to try different builds and strategies. Some are fairly easy and achievable for casual players, while others are truly challenging and will require true mastery of every aspect of the game.
More achievements will be added later.

2) Added markets as stage options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/363ba792d3ae864b4afd4f101d24aebded3dcc5e.png
There are four vendors selling 3 items each, before selecting the stage you can see the vendor type and one item each, and if you buy information more items will be revealed.
You can also sell any of your items at a market stage. (but not relics or minions)
The chance of a market stage coming up depends on the stage number of the current region.
Stage 1: 5%
Stage 2: 10%
Stage 3: 15%
Stage 4: 20%
But you are guaranteed at least one market per region (will appear in stage 4 if it didn't appear before).
You may get a market stage by re-rolling stage options.
Keep in mind that by entering a market you are advancing a stage as usual while skipping a combat and missing the chance to gain experience. Think carefully.

More non-combat stage options will be added soon.

3) New minion: Cyclops Destroyer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/b849f9b2dbc1b24c5fc8108d49a7028a6e3d74e5.gif
The only minion (so far) classified as both humanoid and beast, allowing plenty of singery possibilities. Has very high hit points and physical strength, but very low physical and elemental resistance which makes it vulnerable to debuff effects. Can attack twice and deals stability damage on attacks.
Skills:
- Power dash
- Overcharged (bonus to initiative for each momentum point)
- Break Defense
- Roar
- Full Swing

4) Environment randomization on Skirmishes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/cfb3b0151dae5cff2e071ea63cd9b67813e1ffa6.jpg
The platform and terrain features are not regular and symmetrical anymore, except for runes (formerly known as fountains) which always appear in the center.
Squad Duels and Hero Duels are not affected by this change and are always perfectly symmetrical as usual.

5) You can now discard items to make room for more.

6) Added skill classification icons to text overlays when units perform actions.
This will help new players to better understand what the enemy is doing in their turns.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/f19e4b0d8c282eea2c52cc53a2cd045c194121ca.png
And plenty of other minor improvements to the GUI.


More changes coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.7.0
notes.content:
I listened to all the feedback I got from the playtest and, even though the combat system has been praised a lot, there were some aspects of it that made it unnecessarily complicated and very difficult for new players to get into it.
I put a lot of thought into it and came up with this changes:

1) "Required momentum " and "Momentum Loss" are now the same and called "Momentum Cost". So if a skills has a momentum cost of 3, it means your momentum needs to be at least 3 for activating it, and it will drop by 3 afterwards.
You won't see the arrows up or down next to momentum numbers anymore.

2) All attacks generate momentum on hit, even the ones that consume momentum to activate. 
Attacks now can land Critical Hits, dealing increased damage and generating extra momentum for the attacker.
The base damage multiplier is x1.3 (30% total damage increase), this can be increased by weapons, skills, characters classes, etc...
Base Critical Chance is total Hit Chance minus 100%, so if hit chances is 115%, Critical Chance is 15%.
Now it makes more sense to increase your accuracy and debuff enemy evasion as much as possible.
Minimum Critical Chance is always 5%, anyone can get lucky once in a while!

3) Momentum can now temporarily exceed max momentum, if not used by the end of a turn it drops back to maximum

4) "Required Stability" and "Stability Loss" are now the same and called "Stability Cost". You won't see the arrows down next to Stability numbers anymore.
This was greatly reduced or removed from most skills since it was a very annoying and constant restriction. It remains mostly for Druid Spells only, but they got their AP cost and Momentum cost lowered to compensate for it.

5) Off-hand attacks are now a separated category from attacks. By default units have 1 main attack and 1 off-hand attack per turn (can generate momentum too).

6) Reduced Action Points cost for most spells, abilities and commands. In general, you will now be more limited by Momentum costs than Action Points costs.

7) Greatly reduced Action Points cost for all potions.

8) All heroes now start with an explosive potion, a new item that deals physical and stability damage in area

9) Commands now have shorter range but don't need line of sight

10) All Heroes now have "Aim Legs" attack. Fighters can now learn "Combo Finisher" as replacement.

11) Enemy difficulty in first region slightly reduced, but increased in all other regions.

12) Added new skills to most minions

13) Added effect on attacks to some minions (this include reaction attacks).


The reasoning behind all this may not be obvious, but with all those changes combined the key results are this:
Reducing enemy stablility is now always possible (and quite easy) for any hero, by using "aim legs" attack, "push" (with lower AP cost than before), explosive potion, and "off-hand punch".
There's not such thing as "too much momentum" anymore, you want as much as you can get.
You can now perform more actions per turn on average, with high momentum you have better choices but there's still plenty to do even with zero momentum.
Accuracy and Evasion are more important than ever, since successful attacks generate momentum and criticals generate twice as much. Preventing enemy attacks could be a good way to keep their momentum low.


All this has been tested privately during this last days with very positive results. I'm still making some adjustments but if everything goes well I'll re-open the playtest for everyone soon!


A lot of non-combat changes and other stuff is also on the way, stay tuned for more updates

notes.title: Update 0.6.3
notes.content:
Got a lot of useful feedback from the playtest and I've been working hard to fix all the issues that came up.

I also added new minions to spice things up:

1) Goblin Pyromancer - Level 5
A powerful spellcaster, applies Burn on attacks and gains Momentum whenever an enemy takes damage from Burn. Can cast Inferno and Fire Shield.
Like all goblins, it has low hit points and resistance so try to support it with lots of healing and defensive buffs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/91fd1d5a670441a0d751028a3fa64d6402687ab6.png

2) Imperial Knight - Level 10
Heavy armored melee minion with lots of special attacks, spells and abilities. Can use Prayer to quickly generate Momentum and gets Initiative bonus for each Momentum point.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/ee7798b4de034c3ab193ebc04f57b18a4d8f2cbe.png

3) Spiderling - Level 3
Lightweight beast minon, with bonus damage against isolated minions, applies Poison on attacks and gains Action Points whenever it dodges an attack. A simple and cheap minion that can help a lot in poison-focused squads.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/a4053479534a611bc134f0ce5f2b1fde09efb0c4.png


A lot of balancing has been made, mostly to make the first region easier and quicker on the first stages.

- All Heroes now start with 30 physical and elemental resistance, this will prevent you from taking too much damage on the first levels.

- All heroes get two starting bonuses, instead of one:
Fighter: Medium Armor - Long Bow (in addition to your starting weapon, so you can alternate them during combat)
Druid: Snake - Talisman of Vitality
Cleric: Healer's Tunic - Enchanted Armor
Rogue: Snake Ring - 2 Re-Rolls 
Wizard: Energy Crystal - 2 Potions of Energy
Necromancer: Skeleton Pikeman - Bone Ring

-Some minions now have immunity to certain effects, for example spiders are immune to poison, frost imps are immune to frost and so on. Soon I will also add special items that grant immunities to Heroes.


Thanks a lot to everyone that participated in the playtest, it will remain open until Early Access is ready (estimated by mid January). There's still a lot of room for improvement so any feedback is appreciated.

More changes coming soon!

notes.title: Open Playtest + Update 0.6.1
notes.content:
Playtest Officially Sarted!

Everyone is welcome, just click on "Request Access" and you'll be instantly approved and ready to play.

Please remember to leave feedback after you played, either in the steam discussion or in discord. This helps me to make the game a little better on each update.



New Sub-Classes

1) Barbarian (Fighter Sub-Class)
Perks:
+20 displace strength
+1 resist momentum damage
+2 max momentum

Upgrades:
Weapon Switch grants Fury (3)
+20 stun resistance
+3% initiative per Momentum

Skills:
Stomp: Stuns and deal Stability Damage to all non-flying adjacent enemies.
Bulk Stance: Increase Physical Strength but reduces Evasion while active.
All Out: Attack with increased Base Damage, but apply VULNERABLE (2) to yourself.
Power Dash: Charge in a straight line against any unit. Reduce target's Action Points by 20 and attempt to push it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/9789c1237591c0e27f85cd540c6efd863d267212.gif

2) Shaman (Druid Sub-Class)
Perks:
+1 stability per turn
+20 displace resistance
+40 elemental resistance

Upgrades:
+10% initiative per active stance
+1 spell per turn
+10 HP regeneration per turn

Skills:
Purge: Target any unit with Elemental Effects. Attemp to remove each Elemental Effect and deal Damage for each effect removed.
Disruption Beam: Deals Elemental Damage and apply Breach to all units in a straight line..
Enroot: Increase Physical and Elemental Strength each turn while active.
Teleport: Teleport to a nearby empty tile. Does not require line of sight.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/b10e9f2ad6c28a90d2a845a0182bfb133a87b597.gif

3) Paladin (Cleric Sub-Class)

+20 stun strength
+1 resist stability damage

Prayer grants Fury (2)
+3 Initiative per Stability
+10 physical strength per physical effect

Skills:
Smite: Deals heavy elemental damage and stuns. Can be used only if target dealt direct damage to the caster since previous turn.
Armored Casting: Reduce Spellcasting AP cost penalty from armor.
Mass Protect: Apply Protected (2) to all nearby friendly units.
Condemn: Apply 1 stack of Vulnerable per Momentum to target enemy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/ea6497804dbefa3052a274408df9bee574542985.gif



More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Region Bosses
The 5th stage of each region is now a Boss Fight. It's the only stage choice and cannot be rerolled. More information can be bought as usual.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/48bf4edef6533b6b8425115b0f3aff429aa34da4.png

The Boss is a corrupted Hero representing one of the six main Hero Classes (never multi-class).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/22b7150479a282fde390a8aaff9cdfcf6917691c.gif

For defeating this Boss, you'll be rewarded a Boss Relic (explained next) out of 3 choices, and an extra reward that may consist of:
a) The defeated Boss becomes uncorrupted joins your Squad. You can have up to a total of three heroes simultaneosly (including your main hero), and experience gain will be shared equally between all heroes so this will slow down your main hero leveling.
b) Morale boost for all your units.
c) Experience Bonus.


2) Relics:
Relics grants all kind of passive bonuses, they are always active and they stack with each other. Try to get as many as you can!

Common Relics can be rewards from non-boss combats or purchased in vendors. They offer minor bonuses but will add up nicely.

Boss Relics can only be obtained by defeating a Region Boss. They provide huge bonuses and sometimes a big penalty in return. One single Boss Relic can change your Squad significantly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/a44e260dcce7264eb72d6c523993e68e91b9f5ad.png

Common Relics:
Energy Cristal: +1 Starting Momentum to all your Units
Talisman of Vitality: +10 Max Health to all your Units
Enchanted Armor: +30 Elemental Resistance to all your Heroes
Rune of Protect: Apply PROTECT (3) on a random friendly Unit at the start of each combat
Rune of Ward: Apply WARD (3) on a random friendly Unit at the start of each combat
Feather: +1 Movement to all friendly Flying Units
Snake Ring: Apply POISON (3) on a random enemy Unit at the start of each combat
Scorpion Sting: Whenever POISON is applied on any unit, apply 1 more stack
Bone Ring: +10 Initiative to friendly Undead Units
Enchanted Horseshoe: +15 Elemental Strength and Resistance to friendly Beast Minions
Chocolate Bar: +5 Max Active Minion Level
Beer: All your units gain +5 Morale when resting at a Campsite.

Boss Relics:
Energy Generator: All your units gain +1 Momentum per Turn and -1 Max Momentum
Crown: +15% Initiative to your Main Hero but -10% Initiative to all other friendly units
Whip: +10% Initiative to all friendly Minions but -5 Morale after each combat
Tribal Mask: +20% Max Active Minion level but -1 Active Minion Slot
Rune of Harm: On combat start a random enemy loses 40 Hit Points
Pickaxe: Gain 3 extra Gold per combat for each Reserve Minion

There will be aproximately twice as many relics for early access, and five times as many for the full release!


Progress and Unlocking
Progress between runs is now being tracked and used to Unlock new content.
The idea behind this is to avoid analysis paralysis in new players and intimidating them with too many options at once. Now, only the more beginner friendly options are available at first.

Some Hero Classes are now locked at first, and the player need to each a certain stage to unlock them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/c2993a53ccb33bde08834138900cab003116dca0.png

Within each class, only 4 skills are available at first, the other 4 are unlocked by winning combats with this Class.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/3d8e032ff4c5fbd26dcd8eee485ee554921c071a.png


In-Game Settings
You can now adjust your settings, like in any decent game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/3acce63a142c58bb612af23c9f25cce5afa5aa77.png


Scythe
A new weapon type, with a special attack that heals the Hero if the target is killed. This is the first weapon that focuses on healing and is affected by healing bonuses, which makes it a great choice for healing-focused builds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/4b8b74795f2ba7eb1925d57b29a7fdeb5cec8df8.png


Spellcasting Effects
All spells now have casting visual and sound effects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/c35e1c8e22146edaa7fa8ab85be9ea664b0e7427.gif



And a ton of balancing and bug fixing!
More updates coming soon

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.content:
1) All Heroes and Demon Warchiefs can now use "Commands" on friendly minions once per turn, for a modest cost of Action Points and Momentum. This adds a lot of flexibility regarding how you handle your Squad.
Druids have increased Command range.

Rally Minion: Increase Action Points and Momentum on target minion. This enables your minion to act earlier than expected, maybe earlier than an enemy that would've acted first, the turn order now becomes more flexible and unpredictable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/21e29f88d118b2959b6f85c72c6094c26aea456b.gif

Order Strike: Can be used on minions engaging enemies to trigger an attack. Now you have to be more careful not to let enemies engage your units!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/785645ad71fef25dee0efb1128eebce504dc223a.gif

Order Defend: Target minion adopt a Defensive stance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/cf22d44177b5fbd772d9576f99561e3ec80f5752.gif



2) All Heroes can now unequip their hand items during combat to gain Bare Hand passive bonuses and enable the Punch attack, for 50 Action Points.
Fighters can also equip an alternative weapon set and switch between normal and alternative set or bare hands. They also have an Upgrade to reduce the cost of switching to 20 Action Points.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/8ea232bd93f02b9a5cb15272391e017a59323a67.gif

3) You can now save your run progress! (this was long overdue)
Progress is saved automatically after every action, everything you do is now permanent so think carefully!

4) Added music to all screens. Squad management and combat screens have several different tracks, in combat the unit count and the combat mode will set specific track options. All music tracks could be changed later.

5) Now there are several different soundtracks for each action. Ej: each unit has up to 12 different groan soundtracks and once is picked randomly each time the unit takes damage.


And a lot more minor changes, bug fixes, balancing, AI improvement and so on.
I've been working hard this last weeks and I'm happy to say that the public demo will be ready soon!

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
1.1) You can now Buy Information before selecting your next Stage, to display more enemies, map settings, extra goals and rewards, allowing you to make better decisions. The cost of this information becomes slightly more expensive after each stage.
1.2) You can now spend a re-roll dice to re-roll all aspects of the stage options. Remember that re-rolls are scarce, so use this option wisely.
1.3) Added a "back" button to go back to the Squad Management screen, so you can make any necessary changes after seeing the stage options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/02510cebafce4c67f201414c324c09adc8540c6e.gif


2) You can now buy new minions at any moment, but you are given only two options. One refreshes after every stage, the other refreshes only once per region. You can also spend a re-roll dice to refresh both of them instantly.
This minions are more expensive than in vendors (currently 20%, subject to modification), but they might save you if you are running out of minions and there is no vendor in sight.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43810212/97668cb84290951b813f95ccdb2c852ee4dae2a5.gif


3) Created a new Discord channel to discuss everything related to Squad Tactics! Invite Link: https://discord.gg/V2CQRzPH

From now on, I'll post all updates here (maybe weekly, I think).
Stay tuned!
